name: SiteWatcher
author: nusoft

sections.description:
SiteWatcher – Your Website’s Reliable Monitoring Tool

SiteWatcher scans your website and notifies you whenever it detects changes or concerns. This plugin helps you get your WordPress site set up in SiteWatcher and lets you mute the WordPress update e-mails, so all notifications come from one place.

Key Features:

  • Continuous Monitoring: SiteWatcher consistently checks your website for any modifications or issues, ensuring nothing goes unnoticed.

  • Instant Alerts: Receive immediate notifications whenever SiteWatcher detects significant changes or concerns on your website.

  • Website Health Check: Get regular reports on your website’s uptime, page loading speed, and SEO performance to help you make informed decisions.

  • Content Tracking: Keep tabs on content changes, making it easy to spot unauthorized alterations or accidental deletions.

  • Security Monitoring: SiteWatcher watches for potential security threats, such as the validity of your sites ssl certificate, providing an extra layer of protection.

  • Customizable Alerts: Tailor SiteWatcher’s alerts to suit your specific needs, ensuring you’re informed about what matters most to you.

Why Choose SiteWatcher?

  • Peace of Mind: SiteWatcher offers constant oversight, giving you confidence that your website is in good condition.

  • Time-Saving: It automates the monitoring process, saving you the time and effort of manual checks.

  • Proactive Maintenance: Identify and address issues before they become major problems, ensuring your website stays healthy.

  • Competitive Advantage: A well-maintained website provides a better user experience, helping you stay ahead in your online endeavors.

Don’t leave your website’s health to chance. Try SiteWatcher today and ensure your online presence remains in optimal condition.

Create a free account now

External services

This plugin links to SiteWatcher, an external website monitoring service. The plugin itself does not send any data. When you click “Create a free account”, your browser opens the SiteWatcher sign-up page with your website address in the link, so it can be pre-filled.

  • Terms of service
  • Privacy policy
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  2. Open the SiteWatcher page in the admin menu.
  3. Create a free SiteWatcher account and add your website.
  4. Optionally mute the WordPress update e-mails.
sections.faq:
Do I need a SiteWatcher account?

Yes. The monitoring itself is done by SiteWatcher. You can create a free account at sitewatcher.ai.

Which e-mails are muted?

The e-mails WordPress sends after automatic core, plugin and theme updates. Muting plugin and theme update e-mails requires WordPress 5.5 or newer.

Does this plugin send data from my website?

No. Version 1.4.0 makes no requests to external services. See “External services” below.
sections.changelog:
1.4.0

  • New: Step-by-step getting started page.
  • New: Onboarding notice and “Settings” / “Get started” links on the Plugins screen.
  • Removed: The public sitewatcher/v1/info REST endpoint. It is no longer used by SiteWatcher.
  • Changed: Settings are now kept when the plugin is deactivated, and removed when it is deleted.
  • Changed: Tested up to WordPress 7.1. Requires WordPress 5.0 and PHP 7.0.
  • Fixed: Settings are now sanitized, and links open safely in a new tab.

1.3.2

  • Updated readme and plugin headers.

1.3.1

  • Updated readme and plugin headers.
